description: HiRoN-PL: High-Speed Road Network Vector Data with Construction Year Attribution for Poland (1936-2023) HiRoN-PL: Historyczne dane dotyczące sieci dróg szybkiego ruchu w Polsce (1936–2023) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Przemysław Śleszyński, Katarzyna Krasnodębska (Institute of Geography and Spatial Organization, Polish Academy of Sciences). Dataset description HiRoN-PL is a detailed spatial dataset documenting the development of high-speed road network in Poland between 1936 and 2023. Road geometry is derived from OpenStreetMap (OSM) data. The road network was extracted by selecting all OSM way objects corresponding to high-speed road classes in Poland, namely motorways and expressways (dual carriageways). Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
